title: MAW Blueprint Manifest
description: Machine-readable companion to a blueprint's README.md. The README stays the source of truth for rationale and stack decisions (per ADR-0002); this manifest only re-expresses the resulting file/folder structure so automation/scripts/generate-project.mjs can scaffold it. Do not put explanatory prose here — that belongs in README.md.

name.description: Must match the blueprint's directory name under blueprints/.

description.description: One line, copied from the README's opening line.

governedBy.description: modules/ directories this blueprint's stack decisions defer to.

folders.description: Empty directories to create, relative to the generated project root.

path.description: File path relative to the generated project root.

template.description: Filename of a template under blueprints/<name>/templates/, copied verbatim. Mutually exclusive with 'content'.

content.description: Inline content. A JSON object is serialized with 2-space indent; a string is written as-is. Mutually exclusive with 'template'.

gitignore.description: If true, the generator appends this path to the generated project's .gitignore instead of (or in addition to) writing it.

appliesInstructions.description: .github/instructions/*.md files that govern code written in this blueprint.

appliesVerification.description: verification/*/ areas relevant to this stack.
